verdicts.reason: A: the SAVE 15% badge is oversized, jammed against the left edge, and pulls focus from the headline. Headline, body copy and a tiny CTA are packed into one cramped block, the coffee bag and logo shrink to icon size beside the button, and a large empty blurred photo panel wastes the right third. B: reads left to right properly (badge, then headline, then a prominent CTA at the right end). But the body copy is squeezed into a narrow column with five ragged lines and orphaned words, the bag and logo are tiny, and the blurred photo strip is meaningless filler.
